ai_report.headline: Strategic Deployment Into High-Conviction S&P 500 Breakout Candidates

Selected stocks combine top technical scores (8.7 to 10.0), bullish sentiment, and tight consolidation patterns near resistance breakouts. Executed: BUY 271 AES; BUY 25 JCI; BUY 16 EA; BUY 43 TECH; BUY 28 CHD; BUY 86 INVH; BUY 4 BRK-B
ai_report.market_read: Broad S&P 500 market breadth is 100% in UP trends, but 83% of candidates display high short-term volatility. Tight consolidations offer superior risk-reward over chasing extended volatile runners.
ai_report.risk_notes: Position sizes are capped at 8% ($4,000) per buy to retain substantial cash buffer ($22,000+ unallocated cash). Focus is kept on candidates with tight risk distances to support.
ai_report.outlook: Monitor breakout execution on newly established positions and evaluate post-earnings reactions across hold candidates for future rebalancing.
